page.layout: One printed page: running head at top centre; one text block of full lines in the centre-right; below it a faint block of lines (show-through from the reverse, not transcribed); no margin notes.

main_text.p: Hi sunt qui uenerunt ex magna afflictione, & dilauauerunt stolas suas, & dealbauerunt eas per sanguinem agni. Ideo sunt ante thronum Dei, & seruiunt ei die ac nocte in templo eius, & qui sedet in throno, habitabit super illos, &c.
Regnum ... Christo Deo ... gratia et gloria. Amen. [faint and partly illegible; not reliably read]
main_text.head: FINIS.

page.notes: The running head reads "Apocalypsis cap. 7." with the number in italic. The text block is set in roman type with long s rendered as s. Lines of show-through from the reverse side are not transcribed. The lines below FINIS are very faint and partly illegible; only the signature "Dd ij" is reasonably clear. The verse-like lines in the faint lower block are not reliably legible, so the footnote above is approximate.
